questions.question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

We __all know__ that sugar and honey __tastes__ very __sweet__.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Tastes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the verb form "**tastes**."
 
• The subject of the sentence is "**sugar and honey**," which is a **compound subject** involving two items.
 
• In English grammar, there must be **agreement between the subject and the verb**. If the **subject **is **singular**, the verb **should **be **singular**; if the **subject **is **plural**, the **verb **should be **plural**.
 
• The subject of the sentence is a compound subject because it consists of two items: "**sugar**" and "**honey**."
 
• The correct form should be the plural verb "**taste**" to match the compound subject.
 
• **Corrected Sentence**: *We all know that sugar and honey taste very sweet.*
 
• The correction ensures proper subject-verb agreement, making the sentence grammatically accurate.

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.
